## Planning

Roadmap: #2. Set task ID, phase, priority and current status. Link prerequisites and note any concrete blocker. Read docs/PROJECT_PLANNING.md before starting.

## User need

Who needs this, and what decision or task will it support?

## Expected behaviour

Inputs, outputs, failure behaviour and acceptance criteria.

- [ ] Observable success behaviour
- [ ] Relevant failure behaviour
- [ ] Review, verification and completion evidence recorded

## Proposed branch and checks

Use a feature branch from develop. Describe a meaningful test and the evidence needed to call it complete.

## Scope and deployment

What is included? Which configuration, cost or environment decisions are needed?
